tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Classification of Inner Product Spaces]

↗ prop:gram-schmidt

Finite-dimensional inner product spaces of equal dimension are linearly isometric.
Proof

\sketch Choose orthonormal bases $(v_i)$ and $(w_i)$ by Proposition 1; the unique linear map $F(v_i)=w_i$ is an isomorphism and, by orthonormality, preserves inner products.

□
